question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
WITH constructor_yearly AS (
    SELECT r.year, rs.constructor_id, c.name, SUM(rs.points) as constructor_points
    FROM constructor_standings rs
    JOIN races r ON rs.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON rs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    GROUP BY r.year, rs.constructor_id, c.name
),
best_driver_yearly AS (
    SELECT r.year, rs.constructor_id, c.name, MAX(r2.points) as best_driver_points
    FROM constructor_standings rs
    JOIN races r ON rs.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON rs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    LEFT JOIN results r2 ON r2.race_id = rs.race_id AND r2.constructor_id = rs.constructor_id
    GROUP BY r.year, rs.constructor_id, c.name
),
combined AS (
    SELECT cy.year, cy.constructor_id, cy.name, cy.constructor_points, bd.best_driver_points, cy.constructor_points + bd.best_driver_points as combined_points
    FROM constructor_yearly cy
    JOIN best_driver_yearly bd ON cy.year = bd.year AND cy.constructor_id = bd.constructor_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT constructor_id, name, combined_points, year,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY constructor_id ORDER BY combined_points DESC) as rn
    FROM combined
)
SELECT constructor_id, name, combined_points, year
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
LIMIT 3
